In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 1, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Easy mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

Two words: Sitar Hero.

Nuff said! It really is splendifirus. Who needs a guitar when you can play sitar? Have you ever even seen a sitar? Exactly, they are so cool and popular that you can never ever find one! They get snapped up as soon as they are available. Fact! There is only one way for you to know what I'm talking about, though, and that is to play Sitar Hero for yourself.

Here, I'll give you some pointers on how to play Sitar Hero. First and foremost: Mash those buttons! You will need to run up and down the neck of the sitar to hit certain notes successfully. Sitars are tricky, so you are going to have to hit a note multiple times in order to be given credit. Hey, no one said playing the sitar was easy. Anyway, stick to those tips and you should only have to retry it, like, seventy-ten times.

You will find the teleporter to play Sitar Hero on Easy in Mutanous Malaise, Level 1. I should warn you, it is a popular game, especially with the creatures, so you will have to fight you way in. When you have achieved a perfect score, by collecting all the notes that you hit until you have them all, return to me, Gee Dubya Shrub, in Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Turn-in:

Well, what do you think? Have you ever heard a Sitar rock so hard? I thought not!

Objectives:

  • 8 Polkadot Notes ×8

Client level range: 33–50
